Complaint_Text: A group of stray dogs has become aggressive near the village school and children are afraid to walk to class.
Several injured cattle have been left unattended near the municipal market and require immediate rescue.
Large cracks have appeared in the ceiling of the government community hall and pieces of plaster are falling down.
The public library building has developed severe wall damage and rainwater enters the reading area.
Unauthorized construction is blocking the public pathway leading to houses in our colony.
A shopkeeper has extended the structure onto the footpath, leaving almost no space for pedestrians.
Food served at a roadside restaurant appears unhygienic and several customers complained of stomach problems.
The meat shop near the bus stand is operating in extremely unhygienic conditions with waste left uncovered.
Loudspeakers from a nearby wedding function continue past midnight and residents cannot sleep.
Continuous drilling and machinery noise from a construction site is disturbing families throughout the day.
Several old trees in the public park have fallen after heavy rain and are blocking the walking area.
The children's playground has overgrown weeds and damaged trees, making the park unsafe for visitors.
Stagnant water near our residential area has become a breeding place for mosquitoes and residents fear disease outbreaks.
A large number of mosquitoes are spreading around the colony because open drains have not been treated.
The broken boundary wall of the public school could collapse onto students during school hours.
Government benches and public facilities at the bus stand have been badly damaged and need repair.
An uncovered electrical cable is lying across a busy street and could cause a serious accident.
The damaged railing on the bridge creates a dangerous situation for pedestrians and two-wheeler riders.
Deep potholes have formed on the road connecting our village to the main highway after the monsoon rains.
The road near the government hospital is badly broken and ambulances are facing difficulty reaching the entrance.
Garbage has remained uncollected in our colony for nearly a week and a strong foul smell is spreading.
Overflowing waste near the vegetable market is attracting stray animals and creating an unhygienic environment.
Dirty wastewater is overflowing from a blocked drain and entering houses during heavy rainfall.
The underground drainage line near our street is blocked, causing sewage water to collect on the road.
Streetlights along the road to our village have not been functioning for several nights, making travel unsafe.
The lamp posts near the bus stop remain switched off after sunset and women feel unsafe waiting there.
Vehicles are being parked on both sides of the narrow market road, causing severe traffic congestion every evening.
Illegal parking near the railway crossing is blocking emergency vehicles and creating long traffic delays.
Our colony has not received municipal drinking water for the past four days and families are struggling.
Muddy and foul-smelling water is coming through the public tap connection and residents are afraid to use it.
